"""Preserve the stopped prototype and generate a sharded initial-tree bridge."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast, hashlib, json, re

H=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]; R=H.parents[1]
prototype=H/'lean/InputData145.lean'
literal=R/'milestones/144-countfree-share18/experiments/lean/LiteralData144.lean'
cnf=R/'milestones/144-countfree-share18/lean/LocalWindowCnf/ShareWindow144.lean'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
source=prototype.read_text()
definitions=re.findall(r'^def (part\d+|tree) : InputTree := (.*)$',source,re.M)
assert len(definitions)==105
parts={name:body for name,body in definitions}

def parse(body):
    toks=re.findall(r'InputTree\.\w+|part\d+|\d+|[()\[\],]',body); i=0
    def expr():
        nonlocal i
        t=toks[i];i+=1
        if t.startswith('part'):return ('part',t)
        if t=='InputTree.empty':return ('empty',)
        assert t=='('
        kind=toks[i];i+=1
        if kind=='InputTree.tautology':
            d,b=int(toks[i]),int(toks[i+1]);i+=2
            assert toks[i]==')';i+=1
            return ('tautology',d,b)
        assert kind=='InputTree.node'
        key=int(toks[i]);i+=1;assert toks[i]=='[';i+=1;cl=[]
        while toks[i]!=']':
            if toks[i]!=',':cl.append(int(toks[i]))
            i+=1
        i+=1; left=expr();right=expr();assert toks[i]==')';i+=1
        return ('node',key,cl,left,right)
    ans=expr();assert i==len(toks);return ans

trees={name:parse(body) for name,body in definitions}
def clauses(t):
    if t[0] in ('empty','tautology'):return []
    if t[0]=='part':return clauses(trees[t[1]])
    return [t[2]]+clauses(t[3])+clauses(t[4])

raw=[]
for text in re.findall(r'^def raw\d+ : List \(List Nat\) := (.*)$',cnf.read_text(),re.M):
    raw.extend(ast.literal_eval(text))
assert len(raw)==13224 and clauses(trees['tree'])==raw

def raw_expression(t):
    if t[0] in ('empty','tautology'):return '[]'
    if t[0]=='part':return t[1]+'.clauses'
    return f'({t[2]} :: ({raw_expression(t[3])} ++ {raw_expression(t[4])}))'

def build_expression(t):
    if t[0]=='empty':return 'Snake9.Lrat144.Tree.nil'
    if t[0]=='tautology':return f'(Snake9.LratFast144.perf {t[1]} {t[2]})'
    if t[0]=='part':return t[1]+'.build'
    return f'(Snake9.Lrat144.Tree.node {t[1]} (Snake9.Lrat144.rawMask {t[2]}) {build_expression(t[3])} {build_expression(t[4])})'


settings='set_option maxRecDepth 100000\nset_option maxHeartbeats 0\nset_option Elab.async false\n'
ns='namespace Snake9.ChunkData145\nopen Snake9.InputTree145 (InputTree)\n'
generated={}
def save(name,text):
 p=H/'lean'/(name+'.lean');assert not p.exists(),p
 p.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n');generated[name]=sha(p)

save('ChunkTruthTools145','import InputTree145\nimport LocalWindowCnf.ShareWindow144\n'+settings+ns+r'''
theorem all_take_drop {α : Type} (f : α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : xs.all f = true) (offset count : Nat) :
    ((xs.drop offset).take count).all f = true := by
  apply List.all_eq_true.mpr
  intro x hx
  exact List.all_eq_true.mp h x (List.mem_of_mem_drop (List.mem_of_mem_take hx))

theorem all_of_subset {α : Type} (f : α → Bool) {xs ys : List α}
    (h : xs.all f = true) (hs : ∀ x ∈ ys, x ∈ xs) : ys.all f = true := by
  exact List.all_eq_true.mpr (fun x hx => List.all_eq_true.mp h x (hs x hx))

theorem build_true_of_slice (τ : Nat → Bool) (t : InputTree)
    (xs : List (List Nat)) (offset count : Nat)
    (heq : t.clauses = (xs.drop offset).take count)
    (h : xs.all (fun c => Snake9.LocalWindow.clauseTrue τ
      (c.map Snake9.LocalWindow.decodeLit)) = true) :
    Snake9.Lrat144.TreeTrue τ t.build := by
  apply t.build_true τ
  rw [List.all_map, heq]
  exact all_take_drop _ xs h offset count
#print axioms all_take_drop
#print axioms all_of_subset
#print axioms build_true_of_slice
end Snake9.ChunkData145
''')

positions={};cursor=0;nodepositions={}
def locate(t):
 global cursor
 if t[0] in ('empty','tautology'):return
 if t[0]=='part':
  positions[t[1]]=(cursor,len(clauses(trees[t[1]])));cursor+=positions[t[1]][1];return
 nodepositions[t[1]]=cursor;cursor+=1;locate(t[3]);locate(t[4])
locate(trees['tree']);assert cursor==13224
rawname=lambda j:f'Snake9.LocalWindow.ShareWindow144.raw{j}'
f='(fun c => Snake9.LocalWindow.clauseTrue τ (c.map Snake9.LocalWindow.decodeLit))'
shards=[]
for n in range(13):
 name=f'ChunkTruthParts145{n:02d}';shards.append(name)
 text=f'import ChunkParts145{n:02d}\nimport ChunkTruthTools145\n'+settings+ns
 for i in range(n*8,n*8+8):
  offset,count=positions[f'part{i}'];j=offset//128;last=(offset+count-1)//128;assert last<=j+1
  xs=rawname(j) if last==j else f'({rawname(j)} ++ {rawname(last)})'
  text+=f'theorem part{i}_slice : part{i}.clauses = (({xs}).drop {offset%128}).take {count} := by\n  rw [part{i}_clauses]\n  rfl\n'
  text+=f'theorem part{i}_true (τ : Nat → Bool)\n    (h0 : {rawname(j)}.all {f} = true)\n'
  if last!=j:text+=f'    (h1 : {rawname(last)}.all {f} = true)\n'
  text+=f'    : Snake9.Lrat144.TreeTrue τ Snake9.LiteralData144.part{i} := by\n  rw [← part{i}_build]\n  apply build_true_of_slice τ part{i} {xs} {offset%128} {count} part{i}_slice\n'
  text+='  exact h0\n' if j==last else '  rw [List.all_append]\n  exact Bool.and_eq_true.mpr ⟨h0, h1⟩\n'
  text+=f'#print axioms part{i}_slice\n#print axioms part{i}_true\n'
 text+='end Snake9.ChunkData145\n';save(name,text)

text=''.join('import '+n+'\n' for n in shards)+settings+ns
text+='''theorem start_true (τ : Nat → Bool)
    (h : Snake9.LocalWindow.cnfTrue τ Snake9.LocalWindow.ShareWindow144.cnf = true) :
    Snake9.Lrat144.TreeTrue τ Snake9.LiteralData144.start := by
'''
text+=f'  have hraw : Snake9.LocalWindow.ShareWindow144.raw.all {f} = true := by\n    simpa only [Snake9.LocalWindow.ShareWindow144.cnf, Snake9.LocalWindow.cnfTrue, List.all_map] using h\n'
rawsum=' ++ '.join(rawname(i) for i in range(104))+' ++ []'
for i in range(104):
 text+=f'  have h{i} : {rawname(i)}.all {f} = true := by\n    apply all_of_subset _ hraw\n    intro c hc\n    change c ∈ '+rawsum+'\n'
 term='(List.mem_append_left _ hc)'
 for j in range(i-1,-1,-1):term='(List.mem_append_right '+rawname(j)+' '+term+')'
 text+='    exact '+term+'\n'

def proof(t):
 if t[0]=='empty':return 'Snake9.Lrat144.TreeTrue.nil'
 if t[0]=='tautology':return f'(Snake9.LratFast144.perf_true τ {t[1]} {t[2]})'
 if t[0]=='part':
  i=int(t[1][4:]);off,cnt=positions[t[1]];a=off//128;b=(off+cnt-1)//128
  return f'(part{i}_true τ h{a}'+('' if a==b else f' h{b}')+')'
 k=nodepositions[t[1]]//128
 lit=f'(Snake9.Lrat144.rawMask_true τ {t[2]} (List.all_eq_true.mp h{k} {t[2]} (by decide +kernel)))'
 return f'(Snake9.Lrat144.TreeTrue.node {lit}\n    {proof(t[3])}\n    {proof(t[4])})'
text+='  exact '+proof(trees['tree'])+'\n#print axioms start_true\nend Snake9.ChunkData145\n'
save('ChunkTruthAssembly145',text)
receipt=dict(status='PREPARED_ASSEMBLY_REPAIR2_TRUTH_TRANSFER',source_files_sha256={p.as_posix():sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),prototype,literal,cnf,H/'lean/InputTree145.lean']},generated_sha256=generated,check_order=['ChunkTruthTools145']+shards+['ChunkTruthAssembly145'],generator_source=generation_source,part_ranges=positions,scope='Avoid every full-tree equality: transfer truth from at most two original128-clause chunks per part, then assemble the existing LiteralData144.start by TreeTrue constructors.')
